_doc: PIN-core-db-separation: the record that the core's databases are separate from QNFO's research database. It cites evidence rather than restating it: instances/ultrastable/own-database.json (declaration, checked on every change by `python3 -m foundation owndb --check`) and the live reading below. Closing probe: `python3 -m foundation owndb --check` and `owndb --live`.

migration.from: core tables inside the originating fleet's shared database, in the retired quniverse account (edb167b78c9fb901ea5bca3ce58ccc4b)
migration.to: ultrastable-org (216e97ea-da5e-41e5-af52-af6c0484a7be) and ultrastable-ops (5cd83b52-864a-4510-b062-fc0d9402d06c) in the ultrastable account (81e3a4efb4eb66e613529b87682911bb)

verification.static_check: python3 -m foundation owndb --check (no core Worker config binds a tenant database or a database of the originating fleet; the fleet's ids are the forbidden patterns of doctrine/single-account.json)

live_reading.method: Cloudflare D1 list for account 81e3a4efb4eb66e613529b87682911bb and a sqlite_master count on ultrastable-org, from a cloud session

limits: This shows the core's databases are the core's own and live in the core's account. It does not claim the retired quniverse account holds nothing: zones and some assets remain there (OL-20261118-1, `python3 -m foundation singleaccount --moved`).
